name: Grunge / Alternative Rock
description: The soft-loud paradigm: restrained verses, explosive choruses, a chug-warning pre-chorus between them.

defaults.concept: Grunge-era alternative rock — quiet anxious verses, a rhythmic chug-warning, then a raw wall-of-sound chorus. Dynamics are the primary structural device.

slots.label: Claustrophobic Verse
slots.purpose: FEEL: Anxious, isolated, tightly restrained. PRODUCTION NOTE: Minimalist arrangement. The drum MIDI loop triggers basic rim-clicks and tight closed-hat strokes with zero rolling fill data.

slots.label: The Chug Warning
slots.purpose: FEEL: Imminent dynamic explosion. TRICK: Hit heavy, syncopated, dead-muted guitar scratch strokes on the eighth-note offbeats. The drum pattern accelerates note density using a steady, unaccented snare ramp.

slots.label: Explosive Catharsis
slots.purpose: FEEL: Raw, unhinged, wide wall of sound. PRODUCTION NOTE: Rhythm elements completely drop the tight verse pocket, switching instantly to wide-open, sloshy hi-hat wash patterns and loud kick-snare variations.
